parts.enabledText: Everything is correct, the queries are well written and run successfully.

Interesting approach in the INSERT INTO statements, where you select the id from the other tables. Usually these id-s are hardcoded, but this type of approach can be useful in some cases. Select statements like you have are computationally more expensive than hardcoding id-s and so this approach might not work well in large databases.
One note is that the file format is wrong. Instead of '.txt', it should be '.sql'.
Just as a note, one insert command could also be used to insert multiple values, using this format: INSERT INTO <table> (...) VALUES (...), (...), (...);
Resolve the mentioned issues, resubmit and then I can raise the grade.
